title.zh: 技术 SEO 活体实践

summary.en: Biweekly living technical SEO playbook synced to Google Search Central doc diffs, retired schema types, rendering rules, spam FAQs, and IndexNow.
summary.zh: 每两周同步 Google Search Central 文档变更、废弃结构化数据、SSR 渲染边界、反垃圾 FAQ 与 IndexNow 的可执行技术 SEO 技能。

added: Added back-button hijacking anti-spam audit rule from Google's Nov 2026 Spam Policy FAQ
Added 12 newly documented Google crawlers & Google-Agent verification checks
updated: Updated Search Console Data Feed validation guidance following Nov 2026 doc removal
Tightened SSR HTML-first checklist for zero-JS AI search fetchers
deprecated: Deprecated HowTo, SpecialAnnouncement, CourseInfo, ClaimReview & LearningVideo rich result templates

added: 新增 Google 2026 年 11 月反垃圾 FAQ 中的后退键劫持（back-button hijacking）审查项
补充 Google 新披露的 12 类官方爬虫与 Google-Agent 验证检查

title.zh: GEO 与 AI 搜索引用优化

summary.en: Evidence-backed Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) rules for Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude Search, and Chinese AI search engines.
summary.zh: 基于实证数据的 GEO 优化技能：覆盖 Google AI Overviews / AI Mode、ChatGPT Search、Perplexity、Claude Search 及中文 AI 搜索引用机制。

added: Added Google AI Mode 'Dive deeper' citation formatting & UGC/community proof patterns
Added Chinese AI Search GEO checklist (Baidu AI Search, DeepSeek, Yuanbao, Qwen)
updated: Clarified /llms.txt role: agent tool/skill discovery map, not a search ranking factor
Refined answer-first chunk structure (40–80 word verifiable lead + structured comparison tables)
deprecated: Removed myth that adding keyword-stuffed llms-full.txt dumps improves ChatGPT or Google AIO citations

added: 新增 Google AI Mode “Dive deeper” 引用结构与社区/一手实证加权建议
新增中文 AI 搜索（百度 AI 搜索、DeepSeek、腾讯元宝、通义千问）GEO 适配清单
updated: 明确 /llms.txt 仅用于 Agent 工具与 Skills 发现，并非搜索排名因子
细化 RAG 友好型内容结构（40–80 字首段结论 + 干净 HTML 对比表 + 版本核验时间戳）
deprecated: 移除“堆砌全站文章到 llms-full.txt 能提升引用率”的伪命题（反而助长整站抄袭）
